SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. & S. I. REGISTRY / H. Q. Crime Branch / Station, / Date September 29/31. / File No. ...）
Subject (in full) Anonymous letter re B. Allara
Made by D.S.I. Ovs iannikoff Forwarded by C.D.I. Hunter

Sir,
With reference to the attached anonymous letter, file No.
S.B. D2710, dated August 28, 1931, inquiries go to show that
Mr. B. Allara, Italian, mechanical engineer and sculptor by
profession, arrived in Shanghai about 10 years ago. Shortly
after his arrival here he joined the Shanghai Nanking Railways
as mechanic engineer, and worked as expert for building of
railway bridges. After the building of the railway line was
completed, Mr. B. Allara was dismissed and arrived in Shanghai,
where he joined Mr. Bertuchio, owner of the Bertuchio Marble
Works, Baikal Road. After working for about 3 or 4 years
with the Bertuchio Marble Works, Mr. B. Allara resigned and
joined the Italian Marble Works, 839 North Szechuen Road where
he was employed for about 2 years and then owing to some mis-
understanding between him and Mr. Finocchiaro left the place.
He is employed now by Mr. L. E. Hudec, Architect, 24 The Bund,
as technical engineer and resides at No. B605 Ford Lane. It
appears from enquiries that he is not acquainted with Parboni,
who was arrested at 8 Yuhang Road in connection with counter-
feit note case. There is nothing known to the Police regarding
the alleged connections of B. Allara with counterfeiters and
careful inquiries made by the undersigned failed to substan-
tiate the suspicion.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently
（签名：V. Ovs iannikoff）
D.S.I.
（签名及批注：... 2/9 / 31.）

D.C. (Crime)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 刑事与情报登记处 / 总部犯罪科 / 分局，/ 日期 1931年9月29/31日。/ 档案号 ...）
事由（全称） 关于 B. Allara 的匿名信
由 D.S.I. Ovs iannikoff 呈报 经 C.D.I. Hunter 转呈

先生：
关于所附编号为 S.B. D2710、日期为 1931 年 8 月 28 日的匿名信，经查证显示，B. Allara 先生，意大利人，职业为机械工程师和雕塑家，约于 10 年前抵达上海。抵沪后不久，他加入沪宁铁路公司担任机械工程师，并作为专家参与铁路桥梁的建设。铁路线建成后，B. Allara 先生被解职并来到上海，加入了位于贝加尔路（Baikal Road）的 Bertuchio 大理石厂业主 Bertuchio 先生处。在 Bertuchio 大理石厂工作约三四年后，B. Allara 先生辞职，加入位于北四川路 839 号的意大利大理石厂（Italian Marble Works），受雇约两年，后因与 Finocchiaro 先生发生某些误会而离职。他目前受雇于外滩 24 号的建筑师 L. E. Hudec 先生，担任技术工程师，居住在福特里（Ford Lane）B605 号。调查显示，他与因伪钞案在余杭路 8 号被捕的 Parboni 并不相识。警方对于 B. Allara 与伪造货币者有所关联的说法一无所知，且经卑职仔细调查，未能证实该嫌疑。

此致，
敬礼
（签名：V. Ovs iannikoff）
D.S.I.
（签名及批注：... 1931年9月2日。）

D.C. (犯罪科)

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. I. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2710.
Date 28 - 8 - 31.

Mr. B. Allara, Italian, B.605 Ford Lane
is connected with the other italian Par-
boni in the forged bank notes business.

He has still in his possession a substan-
tial amount of those notes but he is very
carefull in spending them.

A search of his residence will, no doubt,
reveal some important matter, and also an
accurate investigation will bring to good
result.

N. S. Ovsannikoff
Enquiries please. Possibly has a
connection with F.I.R. 1814/31 Saiga
28/8
Heffer
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与情报登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2710。
日期 1931年8月28日。

意大利人 B. Allara，住福特里（Ford Lane）B605 号，
与另一名意大利人 Parboni 有牵连，
参与伪造钞票活动。

他手中仍持有大量此类钞票，但在使用时
非常小心。

搜查其住所无疑会发现一些重要线索，此外，
进行周密调查也将取得良好结果。

N. S. Ovsannikoff
请予查究。可能与 F.I.R. 1814/31 Saiga 有关联
1931年8月28日
Heffer
